text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after the Kawasaki Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Here we are, in Hokkaido~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hokko Tarumae was about to head to Tomakomai, taking Smart Falcon along with her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It all started the day after
my conversation with Smart Falcon at the academy—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...A Tomakomai tour, you say?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'd love for Tarumae-chan
to show me around Tomakomai☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Just as Hokko Tarumae popped her head into the Trainer's office, Smart Falcon made the suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
If it's a request from Falco-san,
I can't say no.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I also kind of...
wanted to take a break...—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay~!
Thanks, Tarumae-chan☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"—Where would you like to go after this, Falco-san?
I've got plenty of great sightseeing spots to recommend."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well then~ Falco wants to visit
somewhere filled with memories for you, Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: A place of memories, is it...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Like around my parents' house~,
near the school, shops I visited often,
places I hung out at a lot, that kind of thing!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Umm...
I don't mind that at all, of course, but...
There are much more interesting places, you know?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks♪
Though for today, that kind of place sounds nice.
choice_data_list: Let me show you the way.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
U-Understood.
If Falco-san is fine with that—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —So this is the park Tarumae-chan played in so much~. It's surrounded by nature, seems like a wonderful place to relax!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes. The atmosphere changes a bit with the seasons, and I really enjoy watching that happen.

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Citizen A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tarumae-chan!
What a surprise, you're back home! Are those your friends from school?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm home.
I came back today to show Senpai around Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Citizen A
text_block_list.text: My husband was worried, saying Tarumae-chan hasn't been posting on Umatter much lately! Are you doing okay?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm okay, I was just resting for a bit.
Tell Uncle that
I'm doing well, too.

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Citizen A
text_block_list.text:
That's great, then! Still,
seeing you here, Tarumae-chan,
sure brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Citizen A
text_block_list.text:
She wore her favorite hat, ran around
the park with so much energy, and gave me
such a cheerful greeting with a big smile.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Aha, so cute!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: A-Auntie! Bringing up old stories is embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after this, Hokko Tarumae's tour of memorable places continued—

text_block_list.name: Bakery Manager
text_block_list.text:
"—We all watched the 'Kawasaki Kinen' the other day!
You're a full-fledged top-class dirt Umamusume now!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Manager!
Saying that in front of Falco is a bit...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah!
Tarumae-chan is definitely a dirt Umamusume
with a bright future ahead of her!

text_block_list.name: Bakery Manager
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Hearing that from Smart Falcon herself...
As expected of you, Tarumae-chan!

text_block_list.name: Bakery Manager
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this is haskap jam made at our place.
Please have some if you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Really!?
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Citizen B
text_block_list.text:
—I still remember Tarumae-chan's very first live concert.
She sang her heart out, and we were all cheering her on.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: That wasn't a real live, just rehearsal, right? But you guys gathered a whole crowd, so—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And so it practically turned into a live concert! Heheh, you sure are loved ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! It's so nice being able to see the ocean~!
Though it's a bit chilly this time of year☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Falco-san.
Were you really okay with how things went today?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Thanks for the wonderful tour♪
Thanks to you—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I got to learn so much about you
and your hometown, Tarumae-chan!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Now then—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I spotted a neat shop earlier, so I'm gonna go grab a souvenir for Flash-san there! I'll text you later~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...My hometown...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: I've been looking at your hometown the whole time.
I've been looking at your homeland this entire time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I remember the day Hokko Tarumae first told me
about her feelings for Tomakomai and her reason for running—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That day, she told me everything.
Her beloved memories of Tomakomai,
and her heartfelt desire to help her hometown."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that moment on, Tomakomai became,
to me, "Hokko Tarumae's hometown"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Wanting to support the strength and warmth of that love for one's hometown...
That was where it all began."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And spending my days with Hokko Tarumae,
I came to experience firsthand the wonderful charms
and warmth of Tomakomai—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it,
I had come to love Tomakomai
just like it was my very own hometown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understand now that it was surely because
I came in contact with Tomakomai
by standing close to Hokko Tarumae's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, what Hokko Tarumae must do from now on
to fulfill her dream is—
choice_data_list: Let's tell everyone about your hometown too.
Let's tell everyone about your hometown too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Using love for one's hometown as a starting point
to get people interested in Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This is Tomakomai's charm that only Hokko Tarumae can convey, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Those who support Hokko Tarumae will surely find it the best gateway to learning about Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: To bring my hometown...—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
…………Ah, I see.
So that's what it was.
Why didn't I realize it sooner?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
All this time...
I've only been sharing "information" about Tomakomai...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Saying Tomakomai is a great place, an amazing place...
I just gathered all the things to be proud of...
and merely recited them without real thought—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In fact, thanks to Hokko Tarumae, I'm quite confident I know Tomakomai's charms as a city inside and out. But still—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...The order was wrong, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Before getting others to know me...
there was something I had to do—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "And yet, I assumed it wouldn't appeal to the masses, so I took it upon myself to cut out the personal elements—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The attention from fans that Hokko Tarumae has earned through her hard work up to this day should still be able to take on any number of forms.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By letting people see a deeper side of her,
I'm sure they'll feel closer to both her and Tomakomai.
We still have a fighting chance……!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae, you idiot! Dummy!! Moron!!!
You big overlord of negativity!!
This is no time to be acting like a fool!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Switch gears, switch gears, switch geeears!!
You get it now, right!?
What you have to do! What must be done!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we want to share Hokko Tarumae's passion far and wide,
taking advantage of this opportunity would surely be the best way.
choice_data_list: We were planning on doing a mini-live anyway!
We were planning on doing a mini-live anyway!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ......I was happy.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Knowing that through me, you came to love Tomakomai, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu.
It's warm, so very warm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding her feelings close to her heart and determined to change the future,
she sprang into action alongside Hokko Tarumae...!
